sentence: This project builds a platform that maps which proteins interact with each other, using mass spectrometry and a mathematical method.
This project builds tools that use artificial intelligence to protect smart systems from attacks and to preserve privacy.
This project measures how long it takes for two locations on a chromosome to come into contact in live yeast cells.
This project builds a framework that helps legged robots move safely over rough and changing terrain by combining machine learning with physical principles.
This project studies how converting one problem into another with quantum computing can support cryptography and the design of algorithms.
This project studies how places marked by scarcity set up and run criminal DNA databases and turn DNA into evidence for the law.
This project builds hands-on lessons about quantum computing, including how to model errors and check how reliable quantum applications are.
This project builds computer vision algorithms for problems such as recognizing activities and events while preserving privacy.
This project studies how ethanol and methanol are converted into acrolein over an iron molybdate catalyst and which reaction steps are involved.
This project builds low-cost robots that move across the body and show bio-signals, to teach biology and computational thinking in elementary schools.
This project builds robotic surfaces of tiny hairs called cilia that sense chemical and thermal changes and steer fluid flows.
This project builds hands-on lessons that teach artificial intelligence and machine learning with real-world problems in healthcare and cybersecurity.
This project tests how four support programs affect a sense of belonging and identity in STEM among low-income undergraduates.
This project studies when the northern Rocky Mountains formed and how they fall apart, using ancient rainwater preserved in volcanic ash.
This project studies how and why the levels of key metabolites inside cells rise and fall in regular cycles.
This project studies the genetics and microbiomes of insects so that insect farming can turn waste into protein for animal feed and human food.
This project studies whether smell processing in a nudibranch mollusc happens in its peripheral nervous system rather than its central nervous system.
This project builds lessons and a web-based tool that test whether large language models reproduce copyrighted materials or reveal private personal information.
